summary: Tested the autonomous-portrait feature (no AI credits). Backend endpoints POST /api/portraits/prompt and POST /api/trading/npcs/portrait/upload-standalone are working correctly (6/6 pytest passed). NPC Forge (Herrero) UI verified end-to-end: all new data-testids present, 'Copiar prompt' populates a Spanish prompt textarea, 'Subir retrato' upload preview works, the 'Generar trasfondo (IA)' button label is correct and the AI portrait button is gone. PDF export from the interactive character sheet triggers a successful download (Regred_Maggot_ficha.pdf) using html-to-image; no fatal JS error blocks the flow.

issues: html-to-image logs non-fatal SecurityError warnings when trying to inline cross-origin Google Fonts CSS rules (fonts.googleapis.com). The PDF is still produced correctly, but fonts inside the PDF may fall back if the browser blocks CSSStyleSheet.cssRules access. Consider self-hosting the fonts or catching these warnings to avoid noisy console output.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/portrait_routes.py still keeps the old /generate endpoint (AI). It is fine to leave it (not called by these screens anymore) but consider adding a note or deprecation to avoid re-introducing AI portrait UI by mistake.

PNJForgeSection.jsx and CharacterSummary.jsx do not currently show a user-visible feedback when navigator.clipboard.writeText() rejects in headless/insecure contexts (fallback toast only says 'Prompt generado...'). Works but a small info toast on failure could improve UX.
seed_data_creation: None persistent (upload-standalone tests write to GridFS but no NPC was saved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Player Character summary flow (data-testids copy-prompt-btn / portrait-prompt-text / summary-portrait-upload2-label) was NOT exercised via UI because reaching the wizard's final step requires many form completions. However the backend /api/portraits/prompt endpoint (which that screen calls) is fully covered by pytest and returns Spanish output as expected; the CharacterSummary.jsx code correctly maps its call and file-upload logic (see lines 52-115). If a full E2E through the wizard is desired later, create a draft directly in db.character_drafts and navigate straight to the summary step.
